source.check: returned unopposed: 'In the Harryville Ward Alderman J. S. M'Ilhagga, Councillors W. Alexander, S. Barr, J. Morrow and W. M'Ninch were returned unopposed' (Belfast News-Letter, 8 May 1958, p. 6)

note: Municipal elections, 21 May 1958. Contests in Town Hall Ward (recorded) and Market Ward (result not yet found). In Harryville Ward the alderman, J. S. M'Ilhagga, and the four councillors were returned unopposed (Belfast News-Letter, 8 May 1958, p. 6). Returned unopposed.
